name: Covered Jar with Carved Lotus Petals
dimensions: Overall: 21.8 cm (8 9/16 in.); Diameter: 24.3 cm (9 9/16 in.)
summary: This jar still has its original cover, which is rare among surviving examples. Its missing knob most likely had the shape of a lotus bud.
